promise: Provide $3.9 billion for the ninth replenishment of the Global Environment Facility, covering July 2026 to June 2030
description: Donor countries pledged $3.9 billion for the ninth replenishment of the Global Environment Facility (GEF-9) on April 9, 2026, with the GEF Council endorsing the programming directions for the July 2026 to June 2030 period. The replenishment supports Integrated Programs across nature, food, urban, energy and health systems, with an aspirational target for blended finance at scale.
